server._comment_url: Uncomment 'url' to make BOTH native shells load the live hosted app instead of the bundle baked into the binary. Because server.js serves the app and proxies /api on one origin, that single URL then drives the website, iOS and Android alike -- and web changes ship without rebuilding either app. Leave it commented to ship a self-contained offline-capable bundle instead (which then needs VITE_API_BASE_URL set at build time).

_comment_entry: The native shell loads mobile.html (the assistant-only bundle), not index.html (the website). Keeping these as separate entry points is what guarantees the app cannot render the desktop site.
